topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening. Everything I've worked for, all the long nights and hard-earned grades, now in question because of a single mistake. I didn’t realize the quotes needed citations, I swear. I’ve always been careful, always tried to do the right thing. Now, everything feels like it’s falling apart. I need to figure out how to fix this, how to show them that it was a genuine misunderstanding, not a deliberate act. It’s just so overwhelming right now, and I’m not sure where to begin or how to make things right.
